name: ui-skills
readmeExcerpt:
# UI Skills



Skills for Design Engineers.

More on [ui-skills.com](https://www.ui-skills.com/)

## CLI

Browse and fetch skills from your terminal.

```bash
npx ui-skills start
npx ui-skills categories
npx ui-skills list --category motion
npx ui-skills get baseline-ui
```

## MCP

Connect agents to the registry over Model Context Protocol.

```
https://www.ui-skills.com/mcp
```

Tools: `list_skills`, `get_skill`

## Playbook

Distilled UI lessons from the best design engineering skills.

[ui-skills.com/playbook](https://www.ui-skills.com/playbook)

## License

Licensed under the [MIT license](https://github.com/ibelick/ui-skills/blob/main/LICENSE).

aiSummary.oneLiner: A curated collection of advanced UI components and micro-interactions built with modern web technologies.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: UI Skills is a repository showcasing highly polished, complex user interface components and micro-interactions. It serves as both a portfolio of advanced frontend techniques and a copy-paste resource for developers looking to elevate their web applications. The components heavily utilize modern CSS features (like Grid, custom properties, and advanced animations) alongside frameworks like React and Framer Motion to create fluid, highly tactile user experiences. The project emphasizes accessibility, performance, and pixel-perfect design, demonstrating how to bridge the gap between static design mockups and fully interactive web elements.
keyFeatures: Advanced micro-interactions: Features complex, physics-based animations and hover states that provide deep tactile feedback to users.
Modern CSS architectures: Demonstrates the extensive use of modern CSS capabilities, including complex masking, blending modes, and container queries.
Framework integration: Built primarily with React and Framer Motion, showing best practices for declarative animation in component-based architectures.
Copy-paste utility: Designed so that individual components can be easily extracted and integrated into existing codebases with minimal friction.
Accessibility focus: Ensures that complex visual components maintain proper semantic structure, keyboard navigability, and screen reader support.

useCases.title: Component Integration
useCases.description: Frontend engineers copy the advanced animation components directly into their SaaS dashboards to quickly improve the visual quality of the application.

useCases.title: Design Inspiration
useCases.description: UI designers browse the interactive examples to discover what is technically feasible with modern web technologies when designing new features.

useCases.title: Skill Development
useCases.description: Junior developers study the source code to learn how to properly orchestrate complex Framer Motion animations and advanced CSS techniques.

useCases.title: Prototyping Polish
useCases.description: Product teams use the library to rapidly add high-fidelity polish to prototypes before presenting them to stakeholders or investors.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Frontend developers, UI/UX designers, and creative technologists looking to implement or study high-fidelity, interactive web components.
